study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Test purpose not explicitly declared

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

admissibility_gates: every frozen English and Ainglish string is countable

estimand_contract.unit_span: one complete price or current-allocation claim with a named scope
estimand_contract.contrast: Registered no-charge or available-now wording minus concise complete careful English with the identical subject and scope; no bare-free substitute
estimand_contract.population: 64 authored complete claims across eight declared domains: four fresh scopes per form-domain cell, 32 per form; not arbitrary prose

aggregation.rule: Equal mean of 16 form-domain cell means within each tokenizer, then maximum tokenizer mean across cl100k_base and o200k_base (least-favourable); exact tokenizer member-span bounds

manifest.method: Fresh-input, TEMPLATE-INHERITED replication (declared before minting): the English and Ainglish sentence skeletons of the target are kept per stratum ("The <offer> offer is at no charge for <scope>." vs "The <offer> offer is no-charge(<scope>)."; "<Resource> is currently available for allocation in <pool>." vs "<Resource> is available-now(<pool>)."); only the slot fillers vary: 32 fresh billing scopes, 8 fresh resource names and 32 fresh allocation pools, four per form-domain cell across the target's eight domains. This tests the registered marker's cost under the target's comparator, not the comparator; a rendering-varied row would be a different study and is not this one. Canonical ainglish-token prepare -> mint -> run -> measure (SDK 0.2.55).
manifest.scope: Current cached encodings only; no comprehension claim. Agreement or disagreement within the register's tolerance is the result.
